about_pullquote: We answer the phone because we remember what it's like to be without heating in winter.
about_para_1: Dickinson Electrical and Heating has been serving Woking for over 15 years. We started because we saw homeowners being overcharged and left waiting days for repairs. Today, we've built our reputation on honest pricing, fast response times, and getting it right first time. Our team of NICEIC-certified electricians and Gas Safe engineers handle everything from emergency callouts to full installations.
about_para_2: We're not a call centre — when you ring, you reach someone local who knows Woking. Hundreds of families and landlords trust us because we turn up when we say we will, explain what needs doing without jargon, and charge what we quote. That's why most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth.
reviews_heading: What Woking Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a dodgy socket that kept tripping the electrics. Called Dickinson at 9pm on a Tuesday — they came out at half nine the same evening. Turned out it was a faulty outlet, replaced it in 20 minutes. Charged exactly what they'd quoted on the phone. Top-notch service and a genuinely nice bloke. Would use again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: My boiler packed in two days before Christmas. Rang around and no one could help. Dickinson came out same morning, diagnosed a dead pump, had a replacement fitted by lunchtime. Probably saved my family from a freezing house. Can't thank them enough. Professional, quick, and fair pricing.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. We needed the whole house rewired — they gave us a clear quote upfront, explained the work, and finished bang on time. No mess, no drama, everything certified and compliant. They're expensive compared to some, but you get what you pay for. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.
